listen_addr.description: IP address (IPv4 or IPv6) to bind the server to.

listen_port.description: Port to listen on (e.g., 8443 for HTTPS or 8080 for HTTP).

worker_processes.description: Number of worker processes to spawn (typically 1–2 per CPU core).

max_connections.description: Maximum simultaneous connections allowed per worker process.

ssl_enabled.description: Enable TLS/SSL (HTTPS). Must be true if serving secure HTTP/2.

ssl_cert_file.description: Path to the SSL certificate chain file (PEM format). Only used if ssl_enabled is true.

ssl_key_file.description: Path to the SSL private key file (PEM format). Only used if ssl_enabled is true.

h2c_enabled.description: Enable cleartext HTTP/2 (h2c) without TLS. Not recommended for production.

request_buffer_size.description: Buffer size (in bytes) for incoming HTTP request headers and body.

response_buffer_size.description: Buffer size (in bytes) for outgoing HTTP response headers and body.

timeout_request.description: Timeout for receiving complete HTTP request headers (in seconds).

timeout_response.description: Timeout for sending complete HTTP response (in seconds).

log_level.description: Logging verbosity: debug, info, warn, error, or fatal.

log_file.description: Path to the main log file.

access_log_format.description: Optional custom access log format (e.g., combined, combined_json, or custom string). If omitted, default combined format is used.

static_dirs.description: List of directories to serve as static content (e.g., for static websites or API docs).

path.description: Absolute filesystem path to the directory.

prefix.description: URL prefix (path) at which this directory is served.

upstreams.description: List of backend servers to use as reverse proxy upstreams (one per group).

name.description: Name of the upstream group (used in routing or default_upstream).

default_upstream.description: Name of the upstream group to use as fallback for unmatched requests. Omit for static-only mode.

initial_window_size.description: Initial peer connection flow control window size (in bytes) per HTTP/2 stream.

max_frame_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) of an HTTP/2 frame to accept.

server_push_enabled.description: Enable HTTP/2 server push (resource preloading). Requires client support.
